import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    void execute() {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = in.readInt();
        int m = in.readInt();
        int s = in.readInt() - 1;
        long t = in.readLong();
        
        GTakeMetro solver = new GTakeMetro();
        int result = solver.compute(n, m, s, t);
        out.printLine(result + 1);
        out.close();
    }

    static class GTakeMetro {
        int compute(int n, int m, int s, long t) {
            long[] lastSeen = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(lastSeen, -1);
            
            while (t > 0) {
                if (lastSeen[s] != -1) {
                    long cycleStart = lastSeen[s];
                    long cycleLength = cycleStart - t;
                    long remaining = t - cycleStart;
                    long cycles = remaining / cycleLength;
                    t -= cycles * cycleLength;
                }
                
                lastSeen[s] = t;
                
                if (s < m) {
                    s = (s + (int)t) % n;
                } else {
                    s = (s - (int)t % n + n) % n;
                }
                
                t--;
            }
            
            return s;
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine(), " \t\n\r\f,");
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int readInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long readLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static class OutputWriter {
        private PrintWriter writer;

        public OutputWriter(OutputStream stream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(stream);
        }

        public void printLine(int value) {
            writer.println(value);
        }

        public void close() {
            writer.close();
        }
    }
}
